posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Played some multiplayer tonight, with actual friends! Ra, Omnitron-X and the Scholar of the Infinite suffered large in the face of advanced Ambuscade in the Enclave of the Endlings. Not an auspicious start!
 
So of course we went on to the next best thing! Bunker, Guise and Chrono-Ranger! In Insula Primalis! Versus Iron Legacy! :D The best part was when Iron Legs overruled a Total Beefcake. It was so funny, we died laughing. No, we actually just died. But it was funny.
 
Then: "Oh god!" said I. "Anything but Miss Information!" And lo, random did gift Eternal Haka, Guise and Omnitron-X with the Matriarch in Pike Industrial. I don't actually know how that one turned out, because everybody disconnected in the middle. I'd like to think we were on the course to winning, however; no doubt this was a cunning plan of the Matriarch's to divest the heroes of their rightful victory! (Guise is, for the record, a dirty, low-down, no-good Component rustler.)
 
So once we pulled our collective butts off the floor, it was off to the Wasteland so Captain Cosmic, Chrono-Ranger and Guise (are you detecting a pattern?) could stomp the Ennead! We ended up fighting four of them in total, and two of us went down, but in the end, it was the Wasteland who gaveth and tooketh away, by which I mean the mutants killed Nephthys for us.
 
For some reason, we fought the Ennead again, this time as Sky-Scraper, Scholar and Fanatic, in Omnitron-IV. We beat a ton of face, lemme tell you. I played Sky-Scraper like I knew what I was doing! :D
 
Lastly, moving underwater, Baron Blade tried to destroy Atlantis. Scholar of the Infinite, Super Scientific Tachyon and Captain Cosmic were there to stop him! I had a great turn where I made Blade hit himself in the face with leak-boosted lightning. TWICE. I had a terrible turn where I hit myself in the face twice! It was good fun. Blade went down like a chump, as he tends to.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Sentinels while waiting on hold! First, Cosmotron in Omnitron-IV, versus Dark Visionary, Wraith, Eternal Haka and DW Nightmist! No Advanced because the environment synergy makes him hard enough. Still lost pretty hard. :(
 
Next, something a little simpler: Omnitron-X, Chrono-Ranger, Visionary, Captain Cosmic and Mr. Fixer versus advanced Akash'Bhuta in Pike Industrial. It was sadly no less pathetic an attempt.
 
So we move on to advanced Voss, invading Insula Primalis, with only Fanatic, the Scholar and Santa Guise to stop him! Unfortunately for the dinosaurs...
 
But Kaargra is always a fun time! Advanced versus DW Expatriette, Nightmist and beardy Ra in the Wasteland, that's the ticket! It was close, but we lost 20-17.
 
So it was time for everyone's favorite standby: advanced Ambuscade in the Enclave! Tachyon, hobo Ra and Omnitron-X finally gave me what I wanted: a nice, relaxing victory. :D
 
But then! More multiplayer madness! Forsooth! Scholar of the Infinite, F6 Wraith and Chrono-Ranger answered the Endlings' call to stop the mad skinwalking god of despair rampaging through their Enclave. The game lasted two. Hours. Chrono went down around hour one and Wraith followed soon after, leaving the Scholar and his three (count 'em!) Flesh to Irons weathering the assault of every single Gloomweaver card. Granted, this meant he was doing 15-20+ damage via Grace Under Fire, but those were few and far between. You cannot imagine the feeling of watching Gloomy be reduced to 2 HP by a late-round GUF, then be hit by Frazzat for 1 more, and then my friends -- my dear, sweet, darling lovable friends -- hitting Choose for Me instead of "Kill Gloomweaver" on the villain turn. It ended up working out, however, as something, I forget what, did the 8 damage necessary to end him, but it was, shall we say, precise.

Akash’bhuta tried to expand her influence to Mars, and the Argent Adept wanted her stopped. So, Tachyon volunteered the use of her Mars Base, bringing Fanatic and Bunker along with her. posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
More multiplayer shenanigans ensue! Haka, Sky-Scraper and the Argent Adept take on Akash-Bhuta in the Final Wasteland! It was a long, grueling fight, but the Wasteland won out in the end, eating Haka's face.
 
Next, Captain Cosmic, Expatriette and Chrono-Ranger tried to stop Deadline from destroying... chaos? Chrono-Ranger cleaned house, just sayin'.
 
Next up, Rook City Wraith, Omni-X and Guise versus the Matriarch in Omnitron-IV? Do you have any idea how terrible an idea this is? After figuring out that I was, in fact, Guise and not Omnitron, we had this exchange:
 
"Omnitron, fix it! We're in your bowels!"
"Your previous bowels. This is where the old poop is."
 
Also, the phrase 'pooping in the future' was sung to the tune of "Running in the 90's". (It's still stuck in my head, help!) Anyway, I'm being flippant because we were doing well until Omnitron (that is, Omnitron-IV) ate all our stuff, letting the Matriach get her emo all over us.
 
Time for something silly! Random gave us TLT, Captain Cosmic and Argent Adept versus La Capitan in Insula Primalis. It was a long fight, but ultimately, Team Support won the day, thanks to ridiculous numbers of Constructs!
 
Lastly, because it's Friday, it was Sky-Scraper, Absolute Zero and Ra versus Plague Rat on Mars! We actually ended up losing, but it was a close game, and it was fun envisioning Absolute Zero and Ra roaming around the Mars base, setting everything on fire and bickering like an old married couple after Sky-Scraper went down.
 
Total Games: 497
